author: Marie382

title: This app made me happier
body:
Hi,

I have a traumatic brain injury and ADHD. Not the best combination. I really struggle with time management  and planning. Negative thoughts are my worst enemy and trying to communicate about them is tough. This app helps me with all of it. 

You can dump you idea’s and thoughts. You can use the judge if you don’t understand what someone is saying. Or you can use it how to give words to what you are feeling and how to communicate better about what you mean.

The compiler function is so nice. You just write everything down without making a list yourself. The magic to do list will help you with creating subtasks and how long the task will take. It is so nice that you can controle how much help you need from the bot. Are you having a bad day and need more steps to complete a task? No problem.

I love this app and would recommend it to anyone.

Much love, Cat
author: Miauwkittie

title: Such a life saver
body:
With my ADHD I can’t always focus on task let alone plan them. Therefore this app has made my life so much easier, it helps with school and with my personal life. 

It has a ToDo AI, a “Judge” that helps you interpret someones message, even a “Chef” that lets you put in the ingredients you have at home and it gives you things you can cook/bake and gives you the entire ingredient list + recipe.

This app has so much more to offer and I’m thrilled to see what this app had in store in the future!
